tenderSchedule.title: Design Manufacture Testing and supply of 66kVCT of ratio 400-200/1-1-1A with Terminal Connectors Marshalling Box required for Transmission Operations Mysuru Zone
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Design, Manufacture, Testing and supply of 66kV Current Transformers of ratio 400-200/1-1-1A with Terminal Connectors, Marshalling Box required for various sub-stations of Operations Divisions coming under Transmission Operations Zone, KPTCL, Mysuru conforming to Technical Specifications, FORD at Store/Site basis, including insurance, transportation & unloading.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CEE Transmission Zone Office Mysuru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidders should upload only scanned original documents (in coloured) to the KPP Portal
The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or partnership firm or a Private firm, Company Registered...

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a manufacturer and should have a minimum experience of 5years prior to this notification in designing, manufacturing, testing of equipments/materials as specified in the tender or higher voltage class. (Bidders must furnish the supporting Documents). (The firm shall enclose P.O. Copies issued by State/Central owned Transmission /Generation Utilities).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) registration and PAN No issued by the Board of Direct Taxes under the Income Tax Act, 1961. The same shall upload the necessary supporting document to establish compliance for having GST registration.

The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or partnership firm or a Private firm, Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013. Note: For other than proprietorship, the Bidder shall furnish the registered partnership deed and Power of Attorney.

The Bidder shall furnish type test certificates not older than (10years)Ten years as on the date of bid opening for having conducted successful type test at CPRI/ERDA NABL accredited Laboratory test house as per the relevant IS/IEC standards on the equipment/material specified in the bid. Bidders shall have to upload the type test certificates of the material/equipment specified in the present enquiry as per the relevant IS/IEC standards

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall furnish the Performance Certificates for at least 30% of the tendered materials or higher than that (of preceding 5 years from the date of bid opening) and the performance certificates should have been issued by the State/Central owned Electricity utilities / Generating utilities only, and issuing officer shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent division head. In the Performance Certificate, the equipment of tendered material Tendered material/equipment or higher than that, should be in successful operation for at least two years as on the date of bid opening. The performance certificate shall be indicating the capacity, make, name of the sub-Division where it is installed, date of commissioning etc., in order to show that tendered materials/equipments of this bid were in successful operation for at least TWO years as on the date of bid opening.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have manufactured at least 80% of the quantity of Tendered material/equipment or higher than that. (Bidders have to furnish the supporting Documents such as P.O).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: In support, Companys Certificate of Incorporation/ Memorandum of Association/ Article of Association of the company in case of Registered Companies under companies act/ Partnership deed in case of Partnership Firm, Registration Certificate of establishment, GoK.

KPTCL at its discretion, may conduct type tests and/or additional type tests as per technical specifications of the subject tender conducted as per the relevant IS/IEC standards at its cost, on a randomly selected Current Transformer by KPTCL officials, at any point of time during the contract at CPRI Laboratory. In case KPTCL opts for conducting type tests and/or additional type tests at CPRI on the randomly selected Current Transformer, the same will be conducted at KPTCLs cost. Applicable testing charges of CPRI shall be paid by the Current Transformer supplier upfront and the same is reimbursable by the KPTCL as per actual, on submission of bills along with proof of payment, on successful passing of tests. However, the transportation and insurance charges shall be borne by the supplier himself. In case of failure of Current Transformer during testing, the Current Transformer will not be accepted by KPTCL and KPTCL will not reimburse the testing charges of CPRI to the laboratory. Further, the order placed on the Firm will be cancelled and the performance Bank Guarantee will be forfeited and Tenderer will be de-barred from participating in KPTCL tenders for a period of 1 year. For all the Current Transformers already supplied, the Tenderer shall furnish an additional two years guarantee and shall extend the validity of Performance Bank Guarantee accordingly. Tenderer shall upload an undertaking agreeing to above criteria and to bear transportation and insurance charges.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any Tenderer/ Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in Section XVI of the tender documents under the heading Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/ Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Tenderer/ Bidder in the following format i)I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India, I certify that this Tenderer/Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Tenderer/ Bidder, fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached/uploaded.ii) I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer/vendor does not have any ToT arrangement requiring registration with the competent authority OR I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/Bidder/ vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer/ Bidder/ vendor has valid registration to participate in this procurement. Self declaration in the prescribed format shall be uploaded
